captions.overview: All complete-source inputs, one ratio each; missing/incomplete sources remain in the source table.
captions.ratio_by_n: Counts label source/size medians; no trend fitting or complexity inference.
captions.values_for_by_k: Same values_for construction; n, mirror and shape shown separately; repeated omitted. Parameter, size, parity and mirror coverage are unbalanced.
captions.ratio_by_split_fraction: One point per input; S=0 yields NA, not zero. No causal interpretation.
